preconditions.description: The number of routers, n, is between 2 and 200000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= p_i < i for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: Each p_i is the index of the router to which the i-th router was connected after being purchased.

postconditions.expression: output is a sequence of distinct integers starting with 1 and ending with n
postconditions.description: The output sequence represents the path from the 1st to the n-th router, with all elements distinct.
